concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: complete high fidelity landing page design concept for VIBE ARCADE, portrait 4:5.
Primary request: Retain Japanese deep urban dark rainy neon aesthetic, but make it genuinely tasteful and epic. This is a small personal arcade for children's games. Mood: cinematic rainy Tokyo backstreet at midnight, intense atmospheric depth, sophisticated photographic realism, subtle futuristic arcade identity. NOT a fantasy storybook.
Background: view down a narrow Japanese alley, charcoal wet buildings, black-blue shadow, rain streaks only visible near real light sources, selective electric teal and muted crimson signage, reflected neon in puddles. One huge restrained vertical Japanese neon sign at edge reading "ゲーム". Distant glow and layers of mist give epic urban scale. Foreground and upper center kept very dark so UI stands clear. Most of the image is beautifully detailed darkness; light is carefully placed.
Page layout: no browser chrome. Tiny top-left "VIBE ARCADE" brand, small "Games" top-right. Large extremely well-designed centered "VIBE ARCADE" headline in strong precise extended sans serif, off-white with subtle cyan rim and NO pink gradient. Under it small copy "Little games. Big imagination." and "Made by dad." Text in empty dark area, no box around intro. Large generous margins.
Two equal large game cards side by side around center-lower page; precision rectangular charcoal panels with modest corners and subtle physical glass depth. Artwork dominates upper section, caption clean and quiet below. SNAPFORGE cover: premium cinematic close-up brick-built miniature futuristic Japanese city street, small colorful brick buildings and recognizably tactile studs, a tiny brick car, wet street, amber windows, controlled teal light, intricate miniature world to build. Label "SNAPFORGE", subtitle "Build little worlds, one snap at a time", understated "Play" button.
STICKERS cover: beautiful layered paper sticker art of a cute fox under a clear umbrella in a Japanese rainy street, small paper cherry tree and glowing shop lanterns, dimensional sticker edges, adorable and coherent, sophisticated illustrated charcoal coral ivory teal palette. Label "STICKERS", subtitle "Stories you can make your own", understated "Play" button.
Quiet footer "More experiments" and "Made by dad".
Constraints: tasteful cinematic cyberpunk city atmosphere, excellent readable UI hierarchy, physically plausible neon reflections and rain, epic depth rather than visual clutter. No matrix rain, fake computer code, scanlines, synthwave grid, holographic HUD, anime people, guns, status badges, gratuitous chrome bevels, giant neon gradient lettering, watermark. Japanese signage belongs to architecture and is sparse. Render as a single polished webpage mockup.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity complete VIBE ARCADE landing page concept, portrait 4:5.
Primary request: EPIC JAPANESE RAINY NEON CITY, sophisticated dark urban arcade aesthetic. Main direction: monumental Japanese city canyon, deep midnight black, elegant neon restrained to real architecture, very cinematic rainy atmosphere.
Scene: low angle view through a dense Japanese downtown street between towering dark buildings, massive architectural silhouettes disappearing into low clouds, distant elevated railway, luminous teal signage on one side and red-orange lantern light on the other, rain and damp asphalt reflecting light. No people prominently visible. Architectural detail atmospheric and rich but lower contrast behind UI. Deeply dark upper middle negative space.
Layout: polished desktop landing page, calm strong graphic design, no browser chrome, no device frame. At top small clean spaced "VIBE ARCADE" wordmark and "Games" link. Main headline "VIBE ARCADE" in huge custom industrial modern off-white sans serif, confident horizontal composition, subtle small red square accent, no gradient fill, no comic style. Small copy "Little games. Big imagination." below and "Made by dad." Typography remains highly legible against darkness.
Main games positioned as two premium poster-like cards side-by-side in the middle of the page, beautifully aligned. Simple matte charcoal architecture for UI, thin barely visible gray borders, labels and buttons clean and sharp.
Left cover shows an exquisite brick-built Japanese arcade storefront at night, tiny tactile brick pieces and studs, bright warm doorway, rainy cyan light, a miniature red-orange brick robot near the door, coherent collectible toy scene. Label "SNAPFORGE", smaller "Build little worlds, one snap at a time", clean small "Play" button.
Right cover shows a gorgeous illustrated sticker collage with a friendly fox under umbrella, paper koi, a crescent moon, Japanese lantern, small paper urban storefronts and puddles arranged into a coherent story scene, dimensional paper edges, moody teal and coral with warm ivory, child-friendly art. Label "STICKERS", smaller "Stories you can make your own", clean small "Play" button.
At bottom small "More experiments" link, tiny "Made by dad" footer. Background extends to edges and becomes darkest around UI captions.
Avoid: Matrix characters, falling symbols, scanlines, garish magenta saturation, 1980s grid, fake data streams, outlined intro box, SYSTEM ONLINE badge, overdecorated panels, ornamental katakana floating above UI, giant bevel text, generic glowing game icons. City signs may use subtle sparse Japanese lettering, anchored to buildings. Premium cinematic scale and physical light, legible useful website design.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: complete art-directed VIBE ARCADE landing page mockup, portrait 4:5.
Primary request: Japanese dark urban rainy neon, elegant and epic, third visual direction: THE HIDDEN ARCADE. An intimate neon-lit Japanese arcade entrance viewed in heavy night rain, exquisite cinematic composition and textures, polished editorial website UI overlay.
Scene: dark narrow Tokyo side street, a tiny beautiful arcade entrance integrated into a weathered charcoal concrete facade, glowing teal Japanese neon sign "遊び" near one edge, muted red lantern across the street, rivulets on window glass, puddles and shimmering light on asphalt, haze and deep shadow. View feels like discovering a special place in the city. No people needed. Background photography quality, controlled neon halation, genuine cinematic darkness, tactile urban materials. No vaporwave.
Composition: near black upper third with subtle rain-lit building contours, large beautiful off-white title "VIBE ARCADE" centered in refined contemporary bold condensed sans serif, subtle single red accent, tiny top navigation logo and Games link. Below title short clear centered text "Little games. Big imagination." followed by small "Made by dad."
Two generous side-by-side game cards with beautiful cinematic artwork, upper art area roughly square, lower crisp flat charcoal caption. Quiet narrow gutters, broad outer margins, simple restrained thin outline and modest corner radius.
SNAPFORGE game cover: a cinematic brightly lit small brick-built Japanese city diorama on a table, shop fronts, tiny brick train, glistening nighttime road, recognizably colorful studded plastic building bricks, rich cyan amber lighting, miniature perspective. Caption "SNAPFORGE", subtitle "Build little worlds, one snap at a time", small "Play" button.
STICKERS game cover: very beautiful handmade paper sticker night street with fox, umbrella, glowing lanterns, puddles and Japanese storefront, layered paper cutouts, ivory peach deep teal, playful expressive art. Caption "STICKERS", subtitle "Stories you can make your own", small "Play" button.
Bottom small "More experiments" and "Made by dad". Real clean UI hierarchy and sharp readable text, game art is clearly the primary interaction.
Constraints: mood-rich dark rainy Japanese neon arcade without noise. Do not make a generic luxury hotel, fantasy landscape, cozy brown library, bright city, literal gaming computer scene, arcade machine product photo. Avoid matrix rain, oversized Japanese characters as decoration, scanlines, grid floor, neon gradient heading, SYSTEM ONLINE badges, hacker HUD, busy borders, huge bloom, watermarks. Use only a couple of Japanese signs as environmental details. Render single cohesive high fidelity webpage concept.
